name: Water, vegetation and bright-surface classes (RGB rules)
description: Rule-based classification of each pixel into water-like, green vegetation-like and other surfaces from true-color bands.
method: class 0 water-like: blue is the largest band and brightness < 0.35; class 1 vegetation-like: ExG (2G-R-B on chromatic coordinates) > 0.05; class 2 other

classification.label: water-like
classification.description: blue is the largest band and brightness < 0.35

compute_source:
def compute(bands, params):
    r, g, b = bands["red"], bands["green"], bands["blue"]
    total = r + g + b
    safe = np.where(total > 0, total, np.nan)
    exg = (2 * g - r - b) / safe
    bright = (r + g + b) / 3.0
    water = (b >= r) & (b >= g) & (bright < 0.35)
    veg = (exg > 0.05) & ~water
    return np.where(water, 0.0, np.where(veg, 1.0, 2.0))
